summary: Retest of the iteration 2 fixes. All passed. Backend: 22/22 pytest pass, including 2 new tests. (1) Every card in the Remote deck (limit 12) has a location that says remote or starts with 'Remote · ', e.g. 'Remote · San Francisco', 'Remote · Singapore +1'. (2) classify() unit test: 'Remote - Texas' and 'Remote - SF Bay Area' are tagged us; 'Toronto, CA' and 'Remote or Hybrid, Toronto' are not; 'San Francisco, CA' still is. Desktop 1920: story beat 3 (story-scene-2) types all 3 sentences with 3 citation chips, then shows 'No fact behind it — cut'. No console errors or warnings at all, so the 'Cannot update a component' error is gone. Compare card on desktop: hover sets aria-pressed true, the first and second click while hovered keep it true, and mouse leave sets it false. Quotes carousel: active dot stays at 0 after 9.5s off-screen and moves to 2 after 9s in view. Mobile 390: the fox chip sits on the same line as 'Get interviews' (top 139 vs 138). The palette toggle is compact (66x36, swatches only), and peach/sky switching works. Mobile beat 2 shows 3 chips and the cut line. A touch tap on a compare card toggles it true, then false. No horizontal overflow (scrollWidth 390). Regression: India region shows Indian locations, Remote region shows remote locations, approve shows 'Queued, not sent' and undo restores it, an invalid email shows an error and a valid one shows success, FAQ item 1 opens and closes.

issues: Fact chips get truncated ('6 yrs produ…', 'Rebuilt onb…') because the column is 34% wide. Cosmetic.
The peach swatch is a pale gradient on a white pill when inactive, so it is hard to see. Consider a darker border or ring. Cosmetic.

action_items: None blocking. Optional cosmetic tweaks: mobile beat-3 chip truncation and the visibility of the inactive peach swatch.
critical_code_review_comments: Typed and SceneDraft: the onDone effect plus stable handlers (useRef with useCallback) is correct. No setState happens during render.

FlipCard checks e.nativeEvent.pointerType !== 'mouse'. A keyboard Enter/Space click gives pointerType '' in Chrome, so keyboard toggling still works. Older Safari, where click is a MouseEvent with no pointerType, also toggles, which is fine.
